t2.thesis: Expectations for META have been reset lower by a sharp pre-print selloff and a 22% EPS estimate cut, but the stock has sold off after three of its last four prints on capex and free-cash-flow worries, and the Q3 print is likely to raise the same concerns, so the outcome is close to a coin flip, slightly below the base rate.
reasons: Cluster and session base rates are about 0.54 (I3).
The bar is lower: the consensus EPS estimate fell about 22% over 90 days, and the stock is down 9.5% over 5 days and 11% below its 52-week high (I2).
Three of the last four reactions were negative, each about 7-11%, driven by cost and capex growth and by legal charges, even after a large beat (I2, I4).
Q2 free cash flow was only $0.78B on $31B of capex, the 2026 capex guide is $130-145B, and youth-related trial risk is still open, so 2027 capex commentary could disappoint again (I4, I5).
Options are balanced: the ATM call IV slightly exceeds the put IV, there is no put skew, and the implied move is about 7.4% (I1, I2).
t2.deciding_variable: 2027 capex and total-expense commentary relative to Q3 revenue and Q4 guidance, i.e. whether ad growth near 28% can justify AI spend that keeps free cash flow near zero.

prior.from: I3 software_internet cluster t0_hit 0.541 (AMC session 0.538, overall ~0.54)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That report falls after my June 2026 knowledge cutoff (and is today's date), so I have no information on how META's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: From 0.54 down to 0.53 (-0.01). The negative reaction pattern on capex and expense guidance roughly cancels the lowered estimates and the pre-print washout. The wide analyst dispersion adds noise but no direction.

theses.mechanism: Revenue near the top of the $61-64B guide and a solid Q4 guide beat a lowered EPS bar after the 9.5% pre-print selloff, producing a relief rally.
theses.wrong_if: Initial 2027 capex or expense guidance is well above the Street, or another large legal charge is taken.

theses.mechanism: A repeat of Q2 and Q1: an expense and capex step-up plus weak free cash flow overwhelms an ad-revenue beat.
theses.wrong_if: Management guides 2027 expense growth materially below revenue growth or signals capex discipline.

theses.mechanism: A mixed print, with an in-line Q4 guide and capex in line with whisper numbers; the overnight move is decided by the tone of the call, within the implied move.
theses.wrong_if: There is a clear surprise in the Q4 revenue guide of more than 3% versus consensus.

key_observations: Q3 revenue vs the $61-64B guide, and the Q4 revenue guide
Initial 2027 capex and total-expense outlook, plus any narrowing of the 2026 capex range
Free cash flow and debt issuance trend
Size of any new legal or youth-trial charges
Ad impression and price-per-ad growth; WhatsApp paid messaging and Muse AI monetization
Severance and headcount savings flowing through operating margin
